verdict.rationale: Factory generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's code and repositories inside the product. `/readiness-report` evaluates a repo's readiness and `/readiness-fix` acts on the failing criteria. `/review` gives "AI-powered insights" on code changes, CI review posts inline feedback, and Droid analyzes the codebase and proposes changes before applying them. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights over non-code data such as usage metrics or Software Factory stage health (those appear only as plain metrics), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
